captured_from: docs/HOOKS.md "Developing Custom Hooks → Hook Input" documents the PostToolUse payload verbatim as `{ session_id, tool_name, tool_input: { command } }`, and its worked example drives a hook with exactly that shape; `cwd` and `transcript_path` are the common input fields the other PAN hooks read (hooks/pan-cost-logger.js). `session_id` is the only field hooks/pan-context-monitor.js reads, and its bridge-file naming `claude-ctx-<session_id>.json` is pinned by tests/context-monitor-hook.test.cjs and tests/statusline.test.cjs. Identity shapes (UUID session id, absolute paths) confirmed against a local Claude Code transcript tree on this machine on 2026-09-17 — structure only, nothing copied out; all values here are neutral synthetic.

placeholders.{{SESSION_ID}}: the host session id; also names the statusline→monitor bridge file
placeholders.{{TRANSCRIPT_PATH}}: absolute path of the session transcript

notes: `tool_response` is omitted: real hosts send one, but no shape for it is evidenced in this repo or on this machine, and pan-context-monitor.js never reads it. The monitor's decision comes entirely from the bridge file the statusline wrote, so the e2e test has to seed that file to reach the emit path — the payload only supplies the session id that names it.
